breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the flexural second moment with a polar moment in the curvature relation, even though beam bending curvature is governed by M/(E I).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the formula κ = M / (E * I), which uses the flexural second moment of area (I). It completely omits the incorrect instruction from the original prompt to use the polar second moment of area (J), thereby fixing the error in alignment with the ground truth.
